epics.title: Restore Backend Network Binding
epics.jtbd: When the orchestrator evaluates the deployed product, I want the backend server to bind to all network interfaces, so that health checks can successfully connect and prove the product runs
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce container health check connection aborts from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The Spring Boot server must bind to 0.0.0.0 to accept connections from outside its container network namespace.

slices.title: Configure Server Address Binding in Application Properties
slices.jtbd: When implementing the network binding fix for this epic, I want to explicitly set server.address to 0.0.0.0, so that the backend service container is accessible from the host orchestrator
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a deployed Spring Boot container
When the orchestrator performs a health check on the exposed port
Then the connection is established successfully without 'RemoteDisconnected' errors
Given the application configuration
When the application properties are loaded
Then server.address is set to 0.0.0.0
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local test loop container connection failures from 100% to 0%
